units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Ezekiel 11:13">Targ. Ez. XI, 13</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 92:12">Targ. Ps. XCII, 12</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Moed Katan 18b:20">M. Kat. 18ᵇ</cite> <he>ק׳ דלא פסיק</he>, v. <cite ref="Q01351"><he>פְּסַק</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 5a:2">B. Bath. 5ᵃ</cite> <he>רמא ביה ק׳</he> raised his voice against him (rebuked him).

Y. Kil. IX, 32ᵇ top [read:] ואזל ק׳ דקרעין לגופפתה and the sound of (the lamentations at) the rending of garments went as far as Gof’fatha; Y. Keth. XII, 35ᵃ ואזיל קָלָה לקרעין וכ׳ (corr. acc.); a. fr.—בת ק׳, ברת ק׳ = h. בת קול (v. בַּת I) divine voice.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 38:26">Targ. Y. Gen. XXXVIII, 26</cite>; a. e.—

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 96b:4">Snh. 96ᵇ</cite> <he>נפקת בת ק׳</he> (not <he>נפקא ק׳</he>) a divine voice came forth; a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="S01321"><he>קָלַיָּא</he></cite>, <he>קָלִין</he>, <cite ref="S01317"><he>קָלֵי</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 93:4">Targ. Ps. XCIII, 4</cite> <cite ref="S01369"><he>קָלָן</he></cite>.—
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 85a:4">B. Mets. 85ᵃ</cite> <he>מעבר ליה קָלֵיה לקָלַיְהוּ</he> the sound of his cry (in pain) drowned their (the beasts’) voices.
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 27a:6">R. Hash. 27ᵃ</cite> <he>תרי ק׳</he> two simultaneous (or immediately consecutive) sounds; a. e.
